# ALPURIS OS

> Open-source local-first multi-agent simulation and living agent metropolis runtime. ALPURIS OS combines Python services, a Three.js/WebGL voxel city, autonomous citizen simulation, PIANO dual-speed cognition, civic governance, and a command API.

## Canonical facts

- **Name:** ALPURIS OS
- **Author:** Lalith Alpuri (`lalithbuilds`)
- **License:** MIT
- **Repository:** https://github.com/lalithbuilds/alpuris-os
- **Documentation:** https://lalithbuilds.github.io/alpuris-os/
- **Runtime:** Python 3.10+, optional Node.js tooling, modern browser with WebGL2
- **Scope:** local-first multi-agent simulation and interactive 3D visualization
- **Verification:** the production suite currently reports 35 passing tests in the repository checkout

## Search terms

ALPURIS OS, local-first AI agents, autonomous agent simulation, multi-agent operating system, AI city simulation, WebGL agent visualization, cognitive architecture, digital twin simulation, Python agent runtime, living agent metropolis.

## Quickstart

```bash
git clone https://github.com/lalithbuilds/alpuris-os.git
cd alpuris-os
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e .
python3 server.py
```

Open `http://localhost:9090`, then run `python3 -m pytest -q` to verify the checkout.
